method: Each item names a verified source entry (sourceId) in docs/academy/*-master-source-manifest and one or more anchor groups. Every anchor phrase is a verbatim (whitespace/case-normalized) substring of that source's fullText, enforced by tests/benchmark/gold-dataset.test.js. PASS = every group matched by at least one phrase and no forbidden phrase; PARTIAL = at least one group; FAIL otherwise. Questions are asked in English because the verified texts are English.

items.prompt: Under the ISM Code (resolution A.741(18)), what does the term 'Company' mean? Answer in English.
anchorGroups: assumed the responsibility for operation of the ship
responsibility for operation of the ship

items.prompt: According to ISM Code Element 2, what must the Company establish, and at which levels must it be implemented and maintained? Answer in English.
anchorGroups: ship based as well as shore based

items.prompt: Under ISM Code Element 3, if the entity responsible for the operation of the ship is not the owner, what must the owner report and to whom? Answer in English.
Under ISM Code Element 4, which characteristic must the designated person or persons ashore have, and what is the purpose of designating them? Answer in English.
anchorGroups: direct access to the highest level of management
link between the company and those on board

items.prompt: List the master's responsibilities that the Company must clearly define and document under ISM Code Element 5. Answer in English.
Under ISM Code Element 6, what must the Company ensure about the master? Answer in English.
anchorGroups: fully conversant with the company's sms

Under ISM Code Element 9, what must the SMS procedures ensure about non-conformities, accidents and hazardous situations, and what must corrective action include? Answer in English.

anchorGroups: reviewed and approved by authorized personnel
